notes.title: Welcome to Freya: The Starfall — Defy Fate, or Be Devoured
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594425/7ac64ab544b7ba3f9d24da12ab50295add65b80e.jpg[/img]

Hello, traveler.

Today, we finally open the Steam page for Freya: The Starfall—a dark fantasy RPG about rebellion, identity, and the choices that shape both your story and your squad.

This is more than a dark fantasy RPG. It’s a game about power, conviction, and the cost of being free.

And here’s why you might want to wishlist it today:

[b]1. Medieval art, reborn by a living legend.[/b]
Every character is brought to life by [b]Sangsoo Jeong[/b], the legendary artist behind [i]League of Legends[/i] and [i]Diablo[/i]. His signature painterly style captures not just form, but story in every stroke—wounds, pride, and purpose etched into every mercenary's gaze.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594425/58173d83d2433c781c989b6f40d08e9c7e595411.png[/img]

[b]2. No two characters are ever the same.[/b]
Each mercenary draws four random skills from a massive pool, along with five unique growth stats. Then you shape them with a deeply flexible talent tree system. What you build isn't just strong—it's yours. One Alicia shields her allies with sacred light—another, a valkyrie of divine fire, burning through all that is corrupt.. One Freya may rise as a grand swordmaster, leading with honor and steel. Another may become the very calamity she once stood against.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594425/85ccc1f5dcee286c65cb50a6ff7fa272a73b7714.jpg[/img]

[b]3. The world doesn’t revolve around you—it reacts to you.[/b]
Each expedition unfolds in a living, AI-driven world where events, conflicts, and beliefs shift as you make choices.
And this isn’t just flavor text. Ideologies matter.
- Characters develop Ideology Traits based on your actions
- Your party forms ideological alignments that grant factional specializations
- Even character abilities change to reflect what they’ve come to believe
What starts as a team of survivors may evolve into something far more dangerous—or heroic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594425/3fe5dc7f1772a0e73a7323f8db7c44434d89c811.jpg[/img]

We’ve poured our hearts into this game—for those who love stories with bite, systems with depth, characters that break the mold, and choices that don’t just end in dialogue—but bleed into the battlefield.

This is just the beginning, and your support today—wishlisting, or sharing the game with a friend—makes all the difference.

We’ll be revealing more in the coming days. Until then: welcome aboard.

Let the rebellion begin. Survive, Starfall. And if possible, protect this last place we can call home.

— The FREYA Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594425/d845486763081cfad458dccc00105533c564e109.jpg[/img]
